انبغين (form VII)
# اِنْبَغَيْنَ (inbaḡayna) /in.ba.ɣaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْبَغَى (inbaḡā)
# اِنْبَغِينَ (inbaḡīna) /in.ba.ɣiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْبَغَى (inbaḡā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
